title: Skillet Chicken with Lemon and Olives
description: Crispy-skinned chicken thighs braised with briny Castelvetrano olives, thin lemon slices, and capers in a pan sauce you'll want to drink. Mediterranean weeknight cooking at its most effortless.

ingredients.name: lemon
ingredients.notes: thinly sliced into rounds, seeds removed

steps.text: Pat chicken thighs very dry. Season generously on both sides with salt, pepper, and oregano.

Heat olive oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat. Place chicken skin-side down and cook without moving until the skin is deeply golden and releases easily from the pan, 7 to 8 minutes. Flip and cook 3 minutes more. Transfer to a plate.
Pour off all but 1 tablespoon of fat. Add garlic and cook until golden, about 1 minute. Add wine (or broth) and scrape up the fond.
Add chicken broth, lemon slices, olives, and capers. Bring to a simmer.

Return chicken skin-side up — keep the skin above the liquid so it stays crisp. Reduce heat to medium-low, partially cover, and simmer until chicken registers 165°F internally and the sauce has reduced slightly, 15 to 18 minutes.
Scatter parsley over the top. Serve straight from the skillet with crusty bread to mop up the sauce.
